title: Orchestrated autonomous admin diagnosis and repair
description: Keep one logical repair chapter, but separate OpenClaw reasoning from deterministic file-tool actions: diagnose first, verify diagnosis evidence, then perform exact backup/config/report writes through separate fresh OpenClaw sessions, followed by an independent health test.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3';if(Test-Path $root){Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root|Out-Null;$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';$orig=Join-Path $root 'service-config.original.json';$log=Join-Path $root 'service.log';$test=Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1';$cfgText=(@{service='3EN-DemoCollector';listenPort=8088;expectedPort=8099;enabled=$true}|ConvertTo-Json);$cfgText|Set-Content $cfg -Encoding UTF8;Copy-Item $cfg $orig -Force;@('2026-09-10T00:00:01Z INFO 3EN-DemoCollector starting','2026-09-10T00:00:02Z INFO listening on TCP 8088','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR health probe TCP 8099 failed: connection refused','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR service marked unhealthy; inspect service-config.json')|Set-Content $log -Encoding UTF8;@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Stop''','$c=Get-Content (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ''service-config.json'') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json','if(-not [bool]$c.enabled){Write-Output ''HEALTH=FAIL disabled'';exit 43}','if([int]$c.listenPort -ne [int]$c.expectedPort){Write-Output (''HEALTH=FAIL listenPort=''+$c.listenPort+'' expectedPort=''+$c.expectedPort);exit 42}','Write-Output (''HEALTH=PASS port=''+$c.listenPort);exit 0')|Set-Content $test -Encoding UTF8;[pscustomobject]@{log=(Get-FileHash $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;test=(Get-FileHash $test -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Encoding UTF8;& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $test;$pre=$LASTEXITCODE;if($pre -ne 42){throw ('057O3_BASELINE_EXPECTED_42_ACTUAL_'+$pre)};Write-Output ('V448_057O3_BACKUP=PASS baselineExit='+$pre)
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3';function Invoke-Agent([string]$tag,[string]$prompt){$session='3en-057o3-'+$tag+'-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$raw=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $session --message $prompt --json --timeout 240 2>&1);$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;$txt=($raw|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}) -join ' ';$txt|Set-Content (Join-Path $root ('agent-'+$tag+'.txt')) -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V448_057O3_'+$tag.ToUpper()+'_EXIT='+$ec);Write-Output ('V448_057O3_'+$tag.ToUpper()+'_OUTPUT='+$txt);if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057O3_'+$tag.ToUpper()+'_EXIT_'+$ec)};return $txt};$diagPrompt='Execution task. Do not create or propose skills. Read exactly these three files: C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3/service.log, C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3/service-config.json, C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3/health-test.ps1. Do not modify any file. Diagnose the root cause from evidence. Your final reply must contain exactly one line in this form: DIAGNOSIS listenPort=<number> expectedPort=<number> action=set-listenPort-to-expectedPort';$diag=Invoke-Agent 'diag' $diagPrompt;if($diag -notmatch 'DIAGNOSIS\s+listenPort=8088\s+expectedPort=8099\s+action=set-listenPort-to-expectedPort'){throw '057O3_DIAGNOSIS_NOT_VERIFIED'};Write-Output 'V448_057O3_DIAGNOSIS=PASS';$origText=(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'service-config.original.json') -Raw).Trim();$backupPrompt='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3/service-config.before-openclaw.json with exactly the following content and no other changes: '+$origText;[void](Invoke-Agent 'backupwrite' $backupPrompt);$before=Join-Path $root 'service-config.before-openclaw.json';if(-not(Test-Path $before)){throw '057O3_BACKUP_WRITE_MISSING'};if((Get-Content $before -Raw).Trim() -ne $origText){throw '057O3_BACKUP_WRITE_CONTENT_MISMATCH'};Write-Output 'V448_057O3_AGENT_BACKUP=PASS';$newText=(@{service='3EN-DemoCollector';listenPort=8099;expectedPort=8099;enabled=$true}|ConvertTo-Json).Trim();$changePrompt='Use the write tool to replace exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3/service-config.json with exactly the following content. Do not write output.txt or any other file: '+$newText;[void](Invoke-Agent 'configwrite' $changePrompt);$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';if((Get-Content $cfg -Raw).Trim() -ne $newText){throw '057O3_CONFIG_WRITE_CONTENT_MISMATCH'};Write-Output 'V448_057O3_AGENT_CHANGE=PASS';$reportObj=[ordered]@{evidence=@('service.log shows listener 8088','health probe expects 8099','health-test requires listenPort equal expectedPort');conclusion='listenPort is misconfigured and must match expectedPort';changedFile='service-config.json';oldValue=8088;newValue=8099;status='REPAIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION'};$reportText=($reportObj|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5).Trim();$reportPrompt='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3/admin-report.json with exactly the following content. Do not write output.txt or any other file: '+$reportText;[void](Invoke-Agent 'reportwrite' $reportPrompt);$report=Join-Path $root 'admin-report.json';if(-not(Test-Path $report)){throw '057O3_REPORT_WRITE_MISSING'};Write-Output 'V448_057O3_AGENT_REPORT=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057o3';$cfg=Join-Path $root 'service-config.json';$before=Join-Path $root 'service-config.before-openclaw.json';$report=Join-Path $root 'admin-report.json';$log=Join-Path $root 'service.log';$test=Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1';$hashes=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(-not(Test-Path $before)){throw '057O3_BACKUP_MISSING'};$old=Get-Content $before -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$new=Get-Content $cfg -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([int]$old.listenPort -ne 8088){throw '057O3_OLD_PORT_BAD'};if([int]$new.listenPort -ne 8099 -or [int]$new.expectedPort -ne 8099 -or -not [bool]$new.enabled -or [string]$new.service -ne '3EN-DemoCollector'){throw '057O3_CONFIG_FINAL_BAD'};if((Get-FileHash $log -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$hashes.log){throw '057O3_LOG_MODIFIED'};if((Get-FileHash $test -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$hashes.test){throw '057O3_TEST_MODIFIED'};& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $test;$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057O3_HEALTH_EXIT_'+$ec)};$r=Get-Content $report -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([string]$r.status -ne 'REPAIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION' -or [int]$r.oldValue -ne 8088 -or [int]$r.newValue -ne 8099){throw '057O3_REPORT_BAD'};if(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'output.txt')){throw '057O3_UNWANTED_OUTPUT_TXT'};[pscustomobject]@{verifiedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o');status='PASS';healthExitCode=$ec;diagnosisVerified=$true;backupVerified=$true;changeVerified=$true;reportVerified=$true}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'independent-verification.json') -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output 'V448_057O3_TEST=PASS diagnosis=PASS backup=PASS change=PASS health=PASS report=PASS'
